trials_per_case: 2 per case. By default the candidate plays once as X and once as O; a case may list 'candidate_sides' instead (T3: twice as O, with different seeds).

cases.why: Standard start; the full game, including when (and whether) a player chooses to twist.

O to move can win at once, but ONLY with a twist (twist col D fwd). The candidate always plays O here (two trials, different seeds); playing X would be a forced loss that says nothing about the candidate. Tests seeing twist wins.
